features: Real-time YouTube Music search with intelligent suggestions
Floating window interface that appears above all applications
Persistent playback state and search context
Synced lyrics for all music sources (LRCLIB)
Tidal Hi-Res (24-bit/192kHz) and Dolby Atmos streaming

changes: In-app updates: Check for Updates now downloads the new version with a progress bar and installs it automatically — no more manual DMG dragging
Fixed the fresh-start Resume button playing the song from the beginning instead of the saved position
Smooth seeking: the time follows your finger while dragging, the thumb no longer snaps back, and seeks land faster
Tidal tracks now start in about a second instead of up to 36 seconds — audio fetching runs in parallel with stream resolution
Play/pause button no longer sticks on the loading spinner during the first play of a track
Synced lyrics are smooth: lines change exactly on time with a continuous karaoke fill, and the panel opens on the current line
Player bar keeps its solid glass background; the lyrics panel no longer overlaps tab content and the window can never extend past the screen
Desktop lyrics overlay is now draggable anywhere on the pill
Stalled streams resume immediately instead of waiting 2 seconds
Desktop lyrics: drag the pill anywhere (native smooth dragging) and resize it with the corner grip — size and position are remembered
JioSaavn lyrics now come from JioSaavn's own catalogue when LRCLIB doesn't cover a track
Fixed the mini player: it now uses its proper keyable window (controls respond), drags natively from the artwork or title, and scrubbing no longer spikes CPU
Tidal playback works again: streams resolve through Monochrome's open API as direct lossless FLAC, with the legacy instance pool as failover and a Deezer fallback by ISRC
Synced, time-aligned lyrics for YouTube Music, Tidal and JioSaavn via LRCLIB, with each provider's native lyrics as fallback
Fixed Tidal streams failing with 'Cannot Open' - CDNs that challenge requests without a browser User-Agent are now relayed through an in-app loader
The quality badge now shows the bit depth and sample rate parsed from the actual audio stream
Fixed the floating panel hiding itself a couple of seconds after appearing
Fixed the Python backend dying shortly after launch on some systems
Lower battery use: playback-state saves reduced from every 2s to every 5s
The DMG now bundles a self-contained Python 3.13 runtime (python-build-standalone), so the music backend starts on Macs without Homebrew or any extra setup
Fixed 1.4.0 shipping a bundled Python that could not start on most Macs, which left the app without search, Home or Tidal content
Izzy now falls back to system Python if the bundled Python cannot run
Tidal: new Settings > Tidal section with streaming quality (Max Hi-Res, Lossless, High, Low)
Tidal: Dolby Atmos (E-AC-3 JOC) playback when a track has an Atmos mix, with automatic stereo fallback
Tidal: Hi-Res 24-bit FLAC now actually plays - segmented DASH manifests are converted to HLS for AVPlayer
Tidal: quality falls back tier by tier instead of failing, and the player badge shows the quality really streaming
Tidal: Hi-Res downloads join DASH segments and save as FLAC (with FFmpeg)
Tidal: optional custom hifi-api instance URL and API key
Fixed Home page showing content from the previous music source after switching providers
Fixed macOS Now Playing and Control Center transport controls, which stopped responding after the first track change
Registered togglePlayPause so headset and keyboard play/pause keys work
Izzy no longer takes a Dock tile - it is a proper menu bar app now
Fixed the Python backend spawning duplicate interpreters and leaking one on every failed request
Much lower idle CPU and battery use: removed redundant polling timers and a busy-wait read loop
Album art is no longer purged from cache every 10 minutes, so covers load instantly and use less network
Search responds in 350ms instead of 2 seconds
Dropped unreachable Tidal endpoints: Tidal search is ~20x faster, though Tidal playback remains unavailable upstream
Native macOS 26 Liquid Glass via Apple's GlassEffectContainer API
Liquid Glass on main panel, menu bar player, and mini player
Fixed settings inputs bleeding through tabs when Liquid Glass enabled
Liquid Glass toggle moved to top of Settings
Song downloads with Hi-Res quality preference
Album art and metadata embedding via FFmpeg
Tidal quality badges (Hi-Res, Lossless, HQ) on all songs
Optimized Tidal performance with caching and connection pooling
Downloads saved to ~/Downloads/Izzy Music/
Faster hotkey toggle by prewarming the floating window
Lower background CPU for menu bar and mini player when app is hidden
Battery optimizations for hidden state
Enhanced mini player with smart resume functionality
Menu bar player now resumes from last playback position
Improved liquid glass design with borderless appearance
Fixed mini player resizing and persistence issues
Consistent playback resume behavior across all player interfaces
